setupDescription: This panel has no users yet. The first account owns it, and creates everyone else.
signInDescription: This panel asks who you are before it answers anything about the host.
twoFactorDescription: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
name: Name
passwordHint: At least 10 characters. There is no password reset by email: run portta auth reset-password on the host.
invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match an account here.
invalidCode: That code was not accepted. Codes change every 30 seconds.
setupClosed: This panel already has an owner. Sign in instead.
openMode: This panel is not asking who you are: it answers on loopback only, where reaching it already means having the machine.
